workload.executor: injected deterministic 0.1s callable; real Worker/Store/HTTP/PostgreSQL; no AgentLoop/model calls
workload.throughput_interval: first HTTP submission through final DB terminal observation; includes duplicate requests and poll delay
workload.worker_connect_ms: pool acquisition plus connection health check (includes setup when needed)

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id, latest_run_id) REFERENCES runs(task_id, id)

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_run ON public.runs USING btree (task_id) WHERE (status = 'RUNNING'::text)
CREATE INDEX run_recovery ON public.runs USING btree (lease_expires_at, id) WHERE (status = 'RUNNING'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_pkey ON public.runs USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_task_id_attempt_key ON public.runs USING btree (task_id, attempt)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_task_id_id_key ON public.runs USING btree (task_id, id)
CREATE INDEX task_dispatch ON public.tasks USING btree (created_at, id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['QUEUED'::text, 'RUNNING'::text]))
CREATE INDEX task_queued ON public.tasks USING btree (created_at, id) WHERE (status = 'QUEUED'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_idempotency_hash_key ON public.tasks USING btree (idempotency_hash)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_pkey ON public.tasks USING btree (id)

database.version: PostgreSQL 16.15 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
